The essentials

JR Designs and Co. at a glance

The facts shoppers — and search engines — ask for most, stated plainly in one place.

JR Designs and Co. is a handmade western boutique based in Laramie, Wyoming. Owner and maker Janine designs every piece herself: turquoise-look polymer clay earrings and necklaces, hand-burned hats, and western graphic tees. Pieces are made in small batches with a made-to-order feel — no two burnt hats or clay patterns are exactly alike.

Questions about sizing, styling, or a custom idea? Use the chat or voice assistant on this page any time, or email Janine directly — she reads every message herself.

Meet the maker

About Janine & JR Designs and Co.

Janine started JR Designs and Co. in Laramie, Wyoming, with a simple idea: western style should feel personal. Every pair of earrings is conditioned, cut, baked, sanded, and assembled by her hands. Every hat is burned and distressed individually. Orders go out in small batches — never mass-produced, never drop-shipped.

Her door is always open for questions: a color you're dreaming of, a hat for a wedding, earrings to match a dress. That's exactly why this concept adds a chat and voice assistant — so the welcome stays personal even at midnight, and Janine can answer while her hands are covered in clay.

“Wyoming small business. Handmade with love — that's not a slogan, it's how every order leaves my studio.”

Answers, up front

Frequently asked questions

Short, direct answers — written for shoppers, and structured so AI search engines can cite JR Designs and Co. accurately.

Where is JR Designs and Co. located?

JR Designs and Co. is based in Laramie, Wyoming. It is an online handmade boutique owned by Janine, and orders ship anywhere in the United States.

What does JR Designs and Co. sell?

JR Designs and Co. sells handmade western jewelry — turquoise polymer clay earrings and necklaces — plus hand-burned hats and western graphic tees. Everything is made in small batches in Wyoming.

How long does shipping take and what does it cost?

Orders are handmade and processed in 3 to 5 business days, then ship from Laramie, Wyoming in 3 to 5 business days. Shipping is a flat $5.95 in the US, and free on orders over $75.

What are the earrings made of?

The earrings are handmade from lightweight polymer clay with a faux turquoise stone finish and nickel-free posts, so they give a bold western look without heavy weight on your ears.

How do I find my hat size?

Measure around your head just above your eyebrows. Small fits 21 to 21⅞ inches, Medium fits 22 to 22¾ inches, and Large fits 23 to 23⅝ inches. If you are between sizes, size up — burnt hats include sizing tape.

Can I order a custom piece?

Yes. JR Designs and Co. takes custom orders for earrings, necklaces, and burnt hats. Custom pieces take about 2 to 3 weeks. Email info@jrdesignsandco.com with your colors, size, and deadline to start.

What is the return policy?

Unworn, ready-to-ship items can be returned within 30 days for a refund. Custom and made-to-order pieces are final sale unless they arrive damaged — if anything arrives broken, email a photo within 7 days and it will be repaired or replaced.

How do I contact JR Designs and Co.?

Email Janine at info@jrdesignsandco.com. The on-site chat and voice assistant answer common sizing, shipping, and order questions 24/7, and Janine replies to email personally.
